note: Croatia: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). A performing artist who is a citizen of an OECD member may work without even a work registration certificate during a short stay (Aliens Act art. 89(6) and (8), with art. 55(1): the Schengen short stay, 90 days in 180); the OECD's 38 members, read from Wikipedia since oecd.org refuses this client, outside the eea list are named here. Every other performer needs a paper for any engagement: a work registration certificate (potvrda o prijavi rada) for up to 90 days in a calendar year (art. 140, point 9), the residence and work permit for longer.

Na temelju potvrde o prijavi rada do 90 dana u kalendarskoj godini mogu raditi sljedeći državljani trećih zemalja: ... 9. umjetnici i tehničko osoblje za operne, baletne, kazališne, koncertne, likovne i druge kulturne priredbe odnosno autori i izvođači na području filmske i televizijske umjetnosti
